 Sandeep Lamichhane bags six wickets; Pokhara Avengers fold for 132 
 Nepal News 
 November 12, 2026 
 1 MIN READ 
 A 
 A+ 
 A- 
 content_copy 
 bookmark_border 
 KATHMANDU: Biratnagar Kings captain Sandeep Lamichhane delivered a devastating spell, claiming six wickets including a hat-trick, to bowl out the Pokhara Avengers for 132 runs in their Nepal Premier League (NPL) clash on Thursday.
 Opting to bat first after winning the toss at the TU Cricket Ground in Kirtipur, Pokhara were dismissed in 17.5 overs despite a lone-hand effort from Yuvraaj Samra.
 Samra top-scored with an explosive 84 off 47 balls, hammering seven fours and five sixes. Dhananjaya Lakshan (22) and Sunny BK (12) were the only other batters to reach double figures.
 Lamichhane tore through the batting lineup, finishing with figures of 6 for 27 in his four-over quota.
 Angelo Mathews, Charith Asalanka, and Rupesh Singh chipped in with a wicket apiece.
 Biratnagar now need 133 runs for victory.
